name: MNRB
recent: MNRB 近期的主要动态包括：发行了 2.5 亿令吉的商业票据，并宣布 FY2026 每股 15 仙的终期股息，同时启动了股息再投资计划。此外，大股东 Amanahraya Trustees、Permodalan Nasional 和 Yayasan Pelaburan Bumiputra 在 10 月至 11 月间有多项持股变动申报。
notable: 公司发行了 2.5 亿令吉的商业票据。
公司宣布 FY2026 每股 15 仙的终期股息。
公司就 FY2026 终期股息启动了股息再投资计划。
risks: 大股东 Amanahraya Trustees、Permodalan Nasional 和 Yayasan Pelaburan Bumiputra 在近期有多项持股变动申报。
earnings: 最近一个季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 8.365 亿令吉，环比增长 12.6%，但同比微降 0.9%；净利为 1.838 亿令吉，环比增长 61.6%，同比增长 9.1%，净利率从上一季度的 15.3% 提升至 22.0%。

recent_en: MNRB's recent developments include the issuance of RM250 million in commercial papers, the declaration of a 15 sen per share final dividend for FY2026, and the launch of a dividend reinvestment plan. In addition, substantial shareholders Amanahraya Trustees, Permodalan Nasional, and Yayasan Pelaburan Bumiputra filed multiple changes in shareholding between October and November.
notable_en: The company issued RM250 million in commercial papers.
The company declared a 15 sen per share final dividend for FY2026.
The company launched a dividend reinvestment plan for the FY2026 final dividend.
risks_en: Substantial shareholders Amanahraya Trustees, Permodalan Nasional, and Yayasan Pelaburan Bumiputra filed multiple changes in shareholding recently.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM836.5 million, up 12.6% QoQ but down 0.9% YoY; net income was RM183.8 million, up 61.6% QoQ and 9.1% YoY, with net margin improving from 15.3% in the previous quarter to 22.0%.
